Benchmark.title: Sample Product Security Benchmark
Benchmark.description: A demo benchmark for a fictional product, showing what the app produces. Rule text is written for this demo; the NIST and CCI references are public mappings.

Rule.title: The product must display a notice and consent banner before granting access.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>A banner shown before logon tells users the system is monitored and what use is authorized. Without one, there is no record that users were told.</VulnDiscussion> <FalsePositives></FalsePositives> <FalseNegatives></FalseNegatives> <Documentable></Documentable> <Mitigations></Mitigations> <SeverityOverrideGuidance></SeverityOverrideGuidance> <PotentialImpacts></PotentialImpacts> <ThirdPartyTools></ThirdPartyTools> <MitigationControl></MitigationControl> <Responsibility></Responsibility> <IAControls></IAControls>
Rule.rationale: Users acknowledge the terms of use before they reach a session.

check.check-content: Start a new session. If no banner with the approved text appears before logon, this is a finding.

Rule.fixtext: Configure the logon banner to display the approved notice.

Rule.title: The product must lock an account after three consecutive failed logon attempts.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Unlimited logon attempts let an attacker guess passwords at leisure. A lockout threshold makes online guessing impractical.</VulnDiscussion> <FalsePositives></FalsePositives> <FalseNegatives></FalseNegatives> <Documentable></Documentable> <Mitigations></Mitigations> <SeverityOverrideGuidance></SeverityOverrideGuidance> <PotentialImpacts></PotentialImpacts> <ThirdPartyTools></ThirdPartyTools> <MitigationControl></MitigationControl> <Responsibility></Responsibility> <IAControls></IAControls>

check.check-content: Review the account lockout setting. If more than three failed attempts are allowed before lockout, this is a finding.

Rule.fixtext: Set the lockout threshold to three failed attempts.

Rule.title: The product must require passwords of at least 15 characters.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Password length is the largest single factor in how long a password takes to crack.</VulnDiscussion> <FalsePositives></FalsePositives> <FalseNegatives></FalseNegatives> <Documentable></Documentable> <Mitigations></Mitigations> <SeverityOverrideGuidance></SeverityOverrideGuidance> <PotentialImpacts></PotentialImpacts> <ThirdPartyTools></ThirdPartyTools> <MitigationControl></MitigationControl> <Responsibility></Responsibility> <IAControls></IAControls>
Rule.rationale: Raises the cost of offline cracking.

check.check-content: Review the password policy. If the minimum length is less than 15 characters, this is a finding.

Rule.fixtext: Set the minimum password length to 15 characters.

Rule.title: The product must protect audit records from unauthorized read access.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Audit records are how an intrusion is reconstructed. If ordinary users can read them, an attacker can learn what is monitored.</VulnDiscussion> <FalsePositives></FalsePositives> <FalseNegatives></FalseNegatives> <Documentable></Documentable> <Mitigations></Mitigations> <SeverityOverrideGuidance></SeverityOverrideGuidance> <PotentialImpacts></PotentialImpacts> <ThirdPartyTools></ThirdPartyTools> <MitigationControl></MitigationControl> <Responsibility></Responsibility> <IAControls></IAControls>
Rule.rationale: Protects the integrity of the audit trail.

check.check-content: Review who can read the audit records. If any non-administrative account can, this is a finding.

Rule.fixtext: Restrict read access to audit records to administrators.

Rule.title: The product must use FIPS-validated cryptography to protect remote sessions.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Remote sessions carry credentials and commands. Unvalidated algorithms may have weaknesses that expose or alter the session.</VulnDiscussion> <FalsePositives></FalsePositives> <FalseNegatives></FalseNegatives> <Documentable></Documentable> <Mitigations></Mitigations> <SeverityOverrideGuidance></SeverityOverrideGuidance> <PotentialImpacts></PotentialImpacts> <ThirdPartyTools></ThirdPartyTools> <MitigationControl></MitigationControl> <Responsibility></Responsibility> <IAControls></IAControls>
Rule.rationale: Confidentiality and integrity of remote administration.

check.check-content: Review the cryptographic settings for remote sessions. If any non-FIPS-validated algorithm is allowed, this is a finding.

Rule.fixtext: Restrict remote sessions to FIPS-validated algorithms.

Rule.title: The product must end a user session after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Rule.description: <VulnDiscussion>Unattended sessions can be used by anyone with physical or remote access to them.</VulnDiscussion> <FalsePositives></FalsePositives> <FalseNegatives></FalseNegatives> <Documentable></Documentable> <Mitigations></Mitigations> <SeverityOverrideGuidance></SeverityOverrideGuidance> <PotentialImpacts></PotentialImpacts> <ThirdPartyTools></ThirdPartyTools> <MitigationControl></MitigationControl> <Responsibility></Responsibility> <IAControls></IAControls>

check.check-content: Review the session timeout. If inactive sessions are not ended within 15 minutes, this is a finding.

Rule.fixtext: Set the inactivity timeout to 15 minutes or less.
